title: Apple HomePod mini 2 Expected to Launch This Autumn: Six Years of Development, AI Chip as the Core of the Upgrade

content_html:
Almost six years have passed since the first release of the Apple HomePod mini, and it is finally set to receive an update. Latest reports indicate that the second-generation HomePod mini could be unveiled as early as this fall, and the delay in updating the product was due to waiting for the maturity of the next generation of Siri. In fact, this is not only the case with the HomePod mini. The new Apple TV 4K, full-size HomePod, and even smart home display devices have also been delayed due to the progress of Apple's AI development. This reflects that AI capabilities have become a key constraint in Apple's hardware iteration, and the software's maturity directly determines the pace of hardware releases.

The current HomePod mini is equipped with the S5 chip, which first appeared with the Apple Watch Series 5 in 2019. In the speaker, this processor mainly handles audio computing and dynamically adjusts sound based on the environment. The second-generation model is expected to use a more powerful processor, and previous rumors suggested it might be the S9 or higher specifications. Although the latest rumors do not specify the exact model, it has been confirmed that the new speaker will feature a faster chip to support local AI computation needs of the new Siri. From the S5 chip to the new chip, the increase in computing power is precisely to enable this small speaker to truly "understand" and "think."

UWB and Audio Quality Both Upgraded

In terms of connectivity, the current model includes a U1 chip, which enables convenient interactions such as device handoff when near an iPhone. Upgrading to more advanced UWB (Ultra-Wideband) hardware is expected to further improve the speed of device identification and response, making cross-device collaboration more accurate and smooth. Additionally, there are reports that the HomePod mini 2 will also offer better audio performance, but specific details about the speaker units, microphone arrays, and acoustic structures have not been disclosed yet.

For Apple, the significance of the HomePod mini 2 goes far beyond a regular update of a speaker. At this critical juncture when Siri is being reshaped by AI, this entry-level smart speaker will serve as an important access point to test Apple's edge AI experience. Whether it can change the reputation of "the weakest voice assistant" with the new chip will be clear this autumn.

content_html_zh:
自 Apple HomePod mini 首次发布以来已经过去了近六年，它终于迎来了更新。 最新报道显示，第二代 HomePod mini 最早可能在今年秋天亮相，而推迟更新产品的原因是等待下一代 Siri 的成熟。 事实上，这种情况不仅限于HomePod mini。 新款Apple TV 4K、全尺寸HomePod，甚至智能家居显示设备也因苹果AI开发的进展而推迟。 这反映出AI能力已经成为苹果硬件迭代的关键制约因素，而软件的成熟度直接决定了硬件发布的节奏。

目前的 HomePod mini 配备了 S5 芯片，该芯片于 2019 年首次随 Apple Watch Series 5 一起出现。 在扬声器中，该处理器主要处理音频计算并根据环境动态调整声音。 第二代机型预计将采用更强大的处理器，此前有传言称可能是 S9 或更高规格。 尽管最新的传闻没有具体说明具体型号，但已证实新扬声器将采用更快的芯片，以支持新 Siri 的本地 AI 计算需求。 从S5芯片到新芯片，计算能力的提升正是为了让这个小音箱能够真正“理解”和“思考”。

UWB和音频质量双双升级

在连接方面，当前型号包含 U1 芯片，可在靠近 iPhone 时实现便捷的交互，例如设备切换。 升级到更先进的UWB（超宽带）硬件有望进一步提高设备识别和响应的速度，使跨设备协作更加准确和流畅。 此外，有报道称 HomePod mini 2 还将提供更好的音频性能，但扬声器单元、麦克风阵列和声学结构的具体细节尚未透露。

对于苹果来说，HomePod mini 2 的意义远远超出了扬声器的定期更新。 在Siri被AI重塑的关键时刻，这款入门级智能音箱将成为检验苹果边缘AI体验的重要接入点。 新芯片能否改变“最弱语音助手”的名声，今年秋天就将见分晓。
